recent_items.title: AnyAccomp: Generalizable Accompaniment Generation via Quantized Melodic Bottleneck

recent_items.title: PRB-WM: Physics-Regularized Beta World Models for Predictive Link Adaptation on Real Time-Varying Underwater Acoustic Channels

recent_items.title: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification with Self-Supervised Pre-Trained Models

recent_items.summary: Speech remains intelligible to listeners under heavy temporal degradation, but whether speaker identity survives is largely unexplored.
